causal_hypotheses.claim: Progressive phase-one reopening will produce observable net XRP withdrawals from Binance-controlled wallets.
support: Official announcement includes XRP in phase one.
disconfirming_or_missing: Status page still exposes no per-asset row.
Internal reshuffling and custody consolidation remain alternatives.

causal_hypotheses.claim: Withdrawn XRP will be sold and create net sell pressure.
disconfirming_or_missing: Self-custody, exchange-to-exchange, institutional custody and OTC routes are alternatives.

causal_hypotheses.claim: Ripple's escrow release caused or was coordinated with Binance withdrawal reopening.
disconfirming_or_missing: No shared transaction, counterparty or flow evidence.

causal_hypotheses.claim: Scheduled GitHub workflows can create/close/assign issues or commit metrics without an explicit per-run human confirmation.
support: auto-resolve-issues has schedule and issues:write; autonomous-resolver has hourly schedule and issues/pull-requests write; daily-digest and self-schedule create issues on schedules; gumroad-metrics commits aggregate metrics to main.
disconfirming_or_missing: No evidence these workflows ran during this research run; actual schedule history not exhaustively inspected.

causal_hypotheses.claim: Barrot Autonomous Resolver is actively collaborating with Copilot.
support: Workflow reads vars.COPILOT_ASSIGNEE and will assign issues/PRs if configured.
disconfirming_or_missing: Variable value not inspected; no authentication or handoff test; no Copilot completion evidence.

exclusions: Do not infer actual XRP withdrawal availability from the announced window or empty status page.
Do not infer a sale from a withdrawal or wallet movement.
Do not infer XRP-specific purchases from Binance's aggregate recovery claim.
Do not infer causality between Ripple escrow and Binance withdrawals.
Do not treat scheduled issue assignment as verified Copilot collaboration.
Do not treat PR CI as main remediation before explicit approval and merge.
Do not infer a no-job push event on a workflow_dispatch-only workflow is a failed approval execution.
